claims.text: SLS Cancun sits in Puerto Cancun's luxury marina community.

findings.quote: Make your entrance in the heart of Puerto Cancún’s luxury marina community

claims.text: The surrounding development includes a 175-slip private marina, boutiques and movie theaters.

findings.quote: a development that includes a beach club, a 175-slip private marina, more than 100 boutiques, movie theaters

claims.text: The hotel opened in 2021 as SLS Hotels & Resorts' first property in Mexico.

findings.quote: SLS Hotels & Resorts finally expanded into Mexico with the 2021 opening of this beachside tower

claims.text: The interiors pair a nautical white-and-navy palette with mid-century-inspired furnishings and wall coverings that draw on Maya motifs.

findings.quote: pair a vaguely nautical white-and-navy palette with low-slung, mid-century-inspired furnishings and bold wall coverings that draw on Maya motifs

claims.text: Cleo restaurant offers a modern take on classic Levantine cuisine.

findings.quote: giving it a modern take on classic Levantine cuisine

claims.text: Bungalow Pool & Beach Club has an eco-chic design inspired by the French Riviera.

findings.quote: an eco-chic design inspired by the French Riviera, Bungalow Pool & Beach Club combines cocktails, food, and entertainment

claims.text: Ciel Spa has herbal steam rooms, a relaxation lounge and a massage suite.

findings.quote: Indulge in the relaxation lounge, massage suite, herbal steam rooms, spacious experience showers

claims.text: The gym schedules yoga, pilates and salsa classes.

findings.quote: plus a schedule of yoga, pilates and salsa classes

claims.text: The hotel offers mixology and cooking classes.

findings.quote: From a private marina and exclusive island golf course to mixology and cooking classes, there is something for every guest to discover.

claims.text: Yacht options include fishing and scuba diving trips.

findings.quote: Yacht and Fishing: Combine luxury with the thrill of the catch.
Yacht and Scuba Diving (PADI not required)

claims.text: The suites were designed by architect and designer Piero Lissoni.

findings.quote: SLS Cancun’s 45 luxury suites promise guests a sumptuous escape. Designed by internationally renowned architect and designer Piero Lissoni

claims.text: Deluxe Oceanfront King rooms have a furnished step-out balcony with a hammock.

findings.quote: Deluxe Oceanfront King Room featuring a 161 sq ft furnished step-out balcony with a hammock

claims.text: Guests get access to an 18-hole golf course designed by Tom Weiskopf.

findings.quote: SLS Cancun guests receive access to an exclusive 18-hole Tom Weiskopf-designed golf course.

claims.text: Private yacht excursions depart from and return to SLS Cancun.

findings.quote: Choose from an array of experiences, each departing and returning to SLS Cancun

claims.text: The hotel has an infinity pool overlooking the Gulf of Mexico and a private beach.

findings.quote: Take a lap in a luxurious infinity pool overlooking the Gulf of Mexico, and relax on our private beach.

claims.text: Golf prices are set and paid at the Clubhouse.

findings.quote: Prices are set and payment is collected at the Clubhouse; prices may vary.

claims.text: Outside visitors can buy pool and beach access through ResortPass.

findings.quote: Reserve a visit to SLS Cancun with ResortPass and receive access to the outdoor pool, white-sand beach, complimentary events and more.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the luxury positioning.
